The Narbutas MEDIA conference wall with high table and VESA mount is designed for modern meeting areas, facilitating presentations and video conferences. It integrates technology seamlessly and offers cable management solutions. The unit is constructed from 0.62" (16mm) MFC (melamine) for front and back panels, and 0.7" (18mm) MFC for sides, with 0.03" (0.75mm) ABS edging on front and back panels. It features height-levelling feet and metal brackets for table connection. The VESA mount is compatible with various standards (3.9x3.9" to 11.8x11.8") and allows for screen height adjustment. The recommended screen size is up to 42" with a weight limit of 33.07 lb (15 kg). The unit must be fixed to a compatible table, such as the NOVA or T-EASY ranges. Dimensions for the media wall are 1200mm x 132mm x 1860mm (W x D x H), and for the integrated high table are 1800mm x 800mm x 1050mm (W x D x H).

EIRA is an office chair designed by Alegre Design to meet the demand for ergonomic, adaptable, and cost-efficient seating solutions in contemporary workplaces. It combines a light form and functionality into a cohesive aesthetic, ensuring intuitive comfort and promoting a healthier sitting posture. The chair features an ergonomically shaped backrest, a weight-sensitive synchronous mechanism, adjustable lumbar support, and optional 2D or 3D armrests and headrest. Up to 43% of its components are made from recycled materials, making it a conscious choice for sustainable workspaces.
OPTIMA PLUS office desk — OPTIMA Plus is an optimal office furniture line which allows you to create a comfortable, functional and well-organized work environment using minimum components.

KOPA by NARBUTAS is a sophisticated soft furniture collection designed by Folco Orlandini, offering a subtle form of everyday luxury for modern office and lounge spaces. Inspired by sand dunes, the collection features gracefully contoured silhouettes and gently voluminous forms, encompassing sofas, lounge chairs, and armchairs. It offers 360-degree comfort, with options for two-tone upholstery and various bases, including solid ash wood or modern metal legs for sofas and lounge chairs, and up to six different bases for armchairs.

The DIVA task chair is designed for intensive, long-duration work, providing dynamic sitting positions, exceptional comfort, and ease of use. It features ergonomic adjustments like a height-adjustable backrest, sliding seat, depth-adjustable polyurethane lumbar support, and options for fixed or 3D adjustable armrests. The chair is available with either a black polyamide or polished aluminum 5-star base with castors.

The Vento 8820 is a high-quality task chair designed for comfort and durability. It features a sturdy frame, adjustable armrests, and a breathable mesh backrest. The chair is designed to provide optimal support and comfort for long periods of sitting.
Denda is a versatile and ergonomic office chair designed for long hours of comfortable sitting. The chair features a breathable mesh backrest, adjustable lumbar support, and a durable metal frame.

SALIDA M is a compact and ergonomic lounge chair designed for modern workspaces. It features a sturdy frame, comfortable cushioning, and a sleek design that fits seamlessly into any office environment.

The Soho Head Desk is a part of the Soho collection by NARBUTAS. The Soho collection is designed to create a comfortable and functional workspace. The Soho Head Desk is a versatile and ergonomic solution for modern offices.

Omega 2 is a high-quality executive chair designed for comfort and durability. It features a sturdy frame, adjustable armrests, and a breathable mesh backrest. The chair is designed to provide excellent support and comfort for long hours of work.

ECHO C - a high-back executive chair designed for top-level executives. Ergonomic design, adjustable lumbar support, and a high back provide comfort during long working hours. The chair's design emphasizes the user's status and creates an atmosphere of trust.

CIFF 30 is a chair designed for conference rooms and auditoriums. The chair has a sturdy metal frame, upholstered seat and backrest. The model is available with or without armrests, and can be customized with various upholstery materials and colors.

Cloakroom system Plaza is designed for public spaces where functionality and durability are crucial. The system consists of modules that can be combined to create a customized solution. Plaza is made of high-quality materials and is designed to withstand heavy use.

Locker S is a compact and versatile storage solution designed for modern workspaces. It features a minimalist design with a focus on functionality and can be easily integrated into various office environments.

The NARBUTAS SURF is a task chair distinguished by its appealing backrest silhouette that resembles a windsurfing sail. Designed by Justus Kolberg, the chair is intended to provide a blend of excellent design and ergonomic comfort. Key features include a breathable mesh backrest with a distinctive three-dimensional structure, height-adjustable lumbar support, and a synchro mechanism that harmonizes the movement of the seat and backrest. The chair offers various adjustments for individual comfort, such as 2D or 3D armrests, seat depth adjustment, and tilt tension control. The SURF chair is available in a wide palette of colors and is designed to fit into both office and home environments.

TANGO is a family of soft seating furniture with a visually striking Scandinavian design, created by the Danish design duo Christina Strand and Niels Hvass. The collection, which includes visitor, conference, and lounge chairs with high or low backrests, is characterized by minimalist, clean lines and a distinctive 'smile' detail in its construction. The frame is made of steel molded with polyurethane and can be upholstered in various fabrics or leather looks, supported by a range of base options including metal and natural or stained ash wood.

The VEGAS lounge chair features a curved shape with a lower and wider seating area for a welcoming and comfortable experience. SIGLE height-adjustable desk designed for dynamic and ergonomic workspaces. Features a motorized sit-stand mechanism, minimalist aesthetic, metal frame construction, and diverse desktop finish options including MFC (melamine) and veneer. Standard height adjustment range from 700mm to 1200mm.
MODUS acoustic desk screens — Height-adjustable or fixed-height acoustic desk screens will offer both privacy and sound absorption sheltering users from general office noise.

TUTTI meeting and conference tables by NARBUTAS. Designed for collaborative spaces, boardrooms, and modern offices. Features a sturdy metal frame construction, cable management integration options, and a durable melamine or veneer top finish. Available in various dimensions (WxDxH) to accommodate small to large team gatherings.

NOVA U bench desks: benches of 2 or 4 desks, extendable with supplementary units up to 6 back-to-back positions. Desk length 1200–1800 mm, back-to-back width 1440 / 1640 mm, 25 mm MFC tops with wire-management cut-outs. Options: NOVA fabric or Plexiglas screens, TOP 530 acoustic screens, horizontal cable trays.

products.model: FLIP TOP II Modular Folding Conference Table
products.description: FLIPTOP mobile conference table for meeting, training and multi-purpose rooms: flip-top modules L 1400 / 1600 × W 700 / 800 × H 735 mm on lockable castors that nest for storage; a folding-leg version is also available.
Horizontal cable tray for NOVA desks and benches — a price-list accessory of the desk system (no product page of its own).
Desktop grommet with power socket box, offered as a price-list accessory of NARBUTAS desk systems (listed with the PLANA executive desks; no product page of its own).
Modesty panel offered as a price-list accessory of NARBUTAS desks (listed with the PLANA executive desks; no product page of its own).
NOVA storage units (cabinets and shelving) used beside the desk as a side return or credenza.
NOVA U single desk on a U-shaped metal frame — the single-position version of the NOVA U bench system.

products.model: PLANA Executive Desk with Side Return
products.description: PLANA executive desk 1800 × 900 or 2200 × 900 mm with a right- or left-hand supplementary unit 1400 × 800 mm (side return), modesty panel, fixed pedestal 900 × 600 mm, grommet and power socket box.
NOVA conference and meeting tables on the NOVA U frame, matching the NOVA desk and bench range.
FONO acoustic desk screens (sound-absorption class A) for desks and benches.

Basic (non-executive) L-shaped corner desk from the NOVA O desk series: 1400x800 left + 1200x800 right desktops, H=740 mm, MFC desktop with ABS edging, metal frame. Modesty panel and under-desk pedestal optional.
NOVA mobile pedestal under the L-shape desk return. Official NOVA pedestal range; drawer configuration per Narbutas price list.
Side return (supplementary) desktop 1200x800 mm, H=740 mm, for NOVA O L-shape corner desk. Matches right-hand return.

Versatile meeting and coffee tables designed for modern collaborative spaces, lounge areas, and executive offices. Features durable top finishes in melamine, laminate, or veneer paired with robust metal or wooden frame structures. Available in various dimensions (WxDxH) to suit diverse breakout and conference layouts.

MOVE is a versatile multifunctional seating and pouf collection designed for dynamic office spaces, collaborative areas, and breakout zones. Features high-density foam padding, durable contract-grade upholstery, and an integrated strap or handle for easy mobility. Dimensions: Width 600mm, Depth 600mm, Height 450mm.

The NOUS lounge chair is designed for comfort and style, featuring a modern aesthetic with clean lines. It is constructed with a durable frame and upholstered in high-quality fabric or leather. The dimensions are approximately 75 cm (width) x 78 cm (depth) x 70 cm (height). The base is typically a metal or wooden frame, providing stability and a sleek finish.

GRAFIK reception desk features a modern architectural design with clean geometric lines, integrated cable management, and durable melamine or veneer finishes. Dimensions: H: 1100mm x W: 1800mm x D: 900mm (standard module). Structure combines particle board covered with melamine or high-pressure laminate (HPL), complemented by metal accents.

The NARBUTAS ACOUSTIC ARTWORK Ceiling system offers PET felt acoustic tiles for suspended ceilings. These tiles are made from recycled PET felt, containing over 50% recycled plastic, and are recyclable. They are designed to improve room acoustics by absorbing medium to high-frequency noise. The tiles are soft, light, strong, and durable, with a porous structure that ensures efficient sound absorption. They are also easy to clean and disinfect. The ACOUSTIC ARTWORK Ceiling system is part of a larger collection that includes partitions, clouds, and wall panels, all aimed at enhancing workspace acoustics and aesthetics. The tiles are available in various shapes and colors to suit different interior design styles. They meet fire classification B-s1, d0 in accordance with EN 13501-1.

COZY is an elegant, modular reception desk system designed by Studio Baltas. It features clean lines, acoustic fabric panels, integrated cable management, optional ambient LED strip lighting along the plinth, and high-durability melamine faced chipboard (MFC) tops with ABS edging. Available in straight, L-shaped, and U-shaped modular configurations.

NRBUTAS CHOICE — The CHOICE collection by Nrbutas features a modular sofa system designed for versatility and comfort, characterized by clean lines, high-quality upholstery, and ergonomic support suitable for modern living spaces.
Ergonomic visitor and conference chair with plastic shell and 4-leg metal frame.
